title: What Is Your Body Doing While You Sleep?
post_title: What Is Your Body Doing While You Sleep? | QuantaTale
post_description: Sleep is not your body switching off. It is busy work. Sources: National Institutes of Health https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/sleep/why-sleep-important and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention https://www.cdc.gov/sleep/about/index.html #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: Is sleep really just your body switching off? Not at all, your body keeps busy looking after your brain and your health. When you first drift off, your heart slows and your blood pressure drops. Sleep also helps you learn and lock in long-term memories. Skimp on it, and you may catch more colds. Here's the cool part: good sleep is about how well you sleep, not just how long. And the hours you need change as you get older.
